scenarios.name: Find drawing entries inside a collapsed resource branch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with a border resource and a sheet border
the drawing resources branch is collapsed in the browser
the user opens the drawing browser search field
the filtered tree shows the matching border resource under its parent branches
the filtered tree shows the matching sheet border
the user clears the search text
the drawing resources branch is collapsed
